description: This file defines a 'DestinationList' UI component using LightningJS framework with Blits. It manages rendering a list of destination cards, including handling empty state, scrolling, and selection logic.

classes.name: DestinationList
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays a scrollable list of destination cards, handles empty states, and provides scroll controls.

methods.name: calcX
methods.description: Calculates the X position for an item based on its index for grid layout.

methods.name: calcY
methods.description: Calculates the Y position for an item based on its index for grid layout.

methods.name: updateThumb
methods.description: Updates scrollbar thumb size and position based on current scroll offset.

methods.name: recomputeScroll
methods.description: Recalculates scroll limits and layout when items change or layout updates occur.

methods.name: $onSelect
methods.description: Handles destination selection events, logs the selected item's title.
